notes.text: The supplied heading explicitly has Rav Acha bar Elyashiv. The stored Midrash Rabbah — TE at Vayikra Rabbah 35:6 has Rabbi Acha ben Elyashiv. Rav/Rabbi and bar/ben remain edition-specific differences; the digital witness does not replace Hyman's wording.
